scope: Branch-specific exact-head offline verification for the bounded REQ-005 fix; not complete REQ-005 delivery or deployment.

environment.dependencies: Unchanged npm v3 lockfile; local existing locked dependencies with official yazl/yauzl additions installed with ignore-scripts in an isolated dependency directory.

ciContract: New pull_request workflow is limited to this repository and codex/req005-summary-progress targeting master. Existing D workflow and branch guard are unchanged.
Checkout the exact event head SHA with pinned actions and persist-credentials:false; contents:read is the only requested permission.

Pinned npm install and npm ci use the official registry, empty configs and ignore-scripts. Reject unexpected workspace links, missing resolved/integrity and foreign resolved URLs before installing the unchanged lockfile.

Validation runs non-root inside a distinct network namespace, with only down loopback, no routes, no capabilities, no-new-privileges and a fresh empty environment/home. No provider or cloud credentials are passed.

Run the unchanged full tsconfig.server.json, then 18 complete related test files with a 30-second per-test timeout and explicit TAP. Pipefail and exact 162-pass/zero-failure/cancelled/skipped/todo totals prevent a partial or empty run from passing.
Check tracked non-symlink test paths, exact head and source integrity before and after validation. No test filters, forced exit, continue-on-error or removed compiler roots are used.

results.typecheckScope: Unchanged tsconfig.server.json, including its three pre-existing exclusions; not a frontend/full-product typecheck.
results.staticValidation: Pass: exact-head/branch/permissions/isolation contract, five invalid lock-source cases, nine incomplete/failing TAP cases. Correct head in the same network namespace and wrong head both fail preflight.

baselineCorrections: All four initial server compiler diagnostics reproduce on immutable master 9ca3388. Null transcript messageId now maps to undefined explicitly, preserving the existing fail-closed rejection and deletion-first checks. Avatar fixture supplies the four existing import ports with its throwing unavailable stub. Handover test asserts the local chat result exists and preserves useful failure diagnostics.

New voice relation regression seals and decodes real typed synthetic records: imported unlinked transcript still rejects with restore_voice_binding/409; the matching local chat-message case succeeds. This does not implement imported-unlinked restoration.

All three initial restore-codec failures reproduce on master: work is now a supported kind so malformed data is invalid, while a separate unknown kind still rejects; reserved photo uploads retain their original upload evidence/objectScope and remain unreadable with a new fence; deleted records retain the authenticated original envelope and tombstone. Assertions now enforce the current documented contract rather than expecting rejection.

The existing restore-service test also fails on master because it expected physical absence of cleanup tombstones. It now asserts exact survivor/two-tombstone identities, body-free deleted state, original scope/deletion/upload evidence, live:false, and retains all revocation, session, barrier, quota and old-epoch checks. Production restore codec/service are unchanged.

Four independent real-worker probes were incorporated: 7,000 and maximum 10,000 emoji sources, atomic long-source repair, and a source correction during provider generation refusing stale persistence.
verificationHistory: The initial new null-transcript fixture used an invalid provenance section, then lacked chat sortKey metadata. Both fixture construction errors were corrected against the real schemas/codec before the final run; neither is claimed as a product bug.

The local workflow-validator harness initially compared arrays across VM realms and failed its own strict equality check. Running the same extracted validation function in the local realm fixed that harness error; the workflow validator itself did not change.

Initial test failures and exact-master comparisons are retained as local receipts. No product quota, restore admission, existing D workflow, package lock or typecheck exclusion was weakened to obtain a pass.

Full legal oversized single-message continuation, interactive-path limits and repair outside the existing four-batch window remain outside this partial REQ-005 change.
